title: gfx1151 enablement for two-node vLLM use
body_excerpt: Community PR enabling gfx1151 similarly to gfx1100. The author reported running rccl-tests across two hosts labeled SH-1 and SH-2, 11/12 tests with NCCL_DMABUF_ENABLE=1, and vLLM tensor-parallel inference across two Strix Halo nodes. The author also reported pipeline-parallel failure unless CUDA graphs were disabled and low throughput on a larger model.
